design_description: A black and dark charcoal jersey with a premium geometric aesthetic. The base uses overlapping angular diagonal panels and fragmented tonal shapes, creating depth while keeping the palette almost entirely black. Warm bronze/gold accents provide the contrast, appearing on the collar, cuffs, logos and thin diagonal lines cutting through the lower body. Fine gold piping also runs along the sides, helping frame the darker central pattern. The combination of matte black geometry and restrained metallic-gold detailing gives the design a sleek, luxury feel — modern, aggressive and sophisticated without becoming overly busy.
